tools.name: create_poll
tools.description: Create a poll anyone can vote on with a link — no sign-up, anonymous by default. AnonPolls doesn't collect accounts or names. Creators see only totals, never who voted for what. To limit repeat votes, it stores a one-way hash of the voter's network address with the vote, not the address itself. Norm

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Read public totals for a poll, the same numbers as the public results page. AnonPolls doesn't collect accounts or names. Creators see only totals, never who voted for what. To limit repeat votes, it stores a one-way hash of the voter's network address with the vote, not the address itself. Normally
